adjacent_closed_family.material_learning: Monthly BTC and zero-yield-cash constant mix reduced allocation drift and drawdown but failed incremental total return in 2023-2024, both fixed neighbors and four-of-five-year breadth. Only 2021 beat its matched static comparator, so the exact BTC-cash family was permanently closed as path-dependent risk control rather than robust alpha.

distinct_mechanism_boundary.not_a_rescue: No BTC target weight, cash allocation, neighboring weight, frequency, trend rule or cost assumption from the closed BTC-cash experiment is changed or rerun.

adversarial_gate_implications: The new family must pass positive incremental total return against its identical two-asset drift comparator in both Design and Validation under normal and stress costs.
The new family must not pass solely by lowering drawdown or keeping weights near fifty percent.
At least four of five fair-reset years must have positive incremental total return and no single year may contribute more than sixty percent of total positive annual increment.
Persistent BTC or ETH leadership that makes rebalancing sell the long-run winner is a falsification result, not permission to add momentum, a band, another frequency or a cash leg.
scope_note: Historical adjacent-family evidence reuse and dedup only. No new-family price value, return, strategy outcome, candidate, OOS or Trading action occurred.
